in_hebrew.name: Mariana
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mariana הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin name ‘Maria’, which comes from the Hebrew name ‘Maryam’. In the New Testament, ‘Maria’ is the name of the mother of Jesus. The name Mariana is derived from the Latin root ‘mar’, which means ‘rebel’ or ‘sea’. Thus, Mariana can be interpreted as ‘rebellious one’ or ‘of the sea’.
